description: This Java interface extends JpaRepository to provide data access methods for UserCreatedShelf entities. It includes custom query methods for fetching shelves by user, shelf name, id, and checking existence of a shelf name case-insensitively.
external_methods: JpaRepository's methods (e.g., save, findById, findAll, delete)
EntityGraph; no specific external methods used
Query; no specific external methods used
Param; no specific external methods used

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for performing CRUD and custom queries on UserCreatedShelf entities.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all shelves associated with a specific user, using an entity graph to fetch associated books efficiently.

methods.name: findByShelfNameAndUser
methods.description: Retrieves a UserCreatedShelf matching the specified shelf name and user, using an entity graph to include related books.

methods.name: findByShelfName
methods.description: Finds all shelves with the specified shelf name, including associated books via entity graph.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a shelf by its ID, including related books via entity graph.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all UserCreatedShelf records, with books fetched eagerly.

methods.name: shelfNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a shelf with the given name exists, case-insensitively and ignoring leading/trailing whitespace.

calls: JpaRepository methods (e.g., save, findById, findAll, delete)
